info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Acanthit Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Acanthit Drill Detail Catalog API enables users to establish and manage detailed entries for Acanthit drill products. This API facilitates the addition of new drill specifications, technical attributes, and related metadata. Primarily targeted at procurement teams and inventory managers, it allows efficient cataloging and organization of drill assets within a broader product catalog ecosystem. Developers can utilize this API to integrate drill details seamlessly into existing workflows or platforms.

post.summary: Create details for an Acanthit drill.
post.description: This operation allows users to create and submit details for an Acanthit drill, ensuring that all necessary information is captured for successful record-keeping and further processing.
